newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France Europe unions extend strike to Fri/Sat.
newsitem.headline: Air France Europe unions extend strike to Fri/Sat.

text.p: Three unions representing pilots and flight engineers at Air France Europe have extended a 14-day strike for another two days to cover Friday and Saturday, the SPNT trade union said on Friday.

The union said they had decided on Thursday, day 14 of a strike, to renew for a further 48 hours their protest against plans to merge the short-haul carrier with parent company Air France, which they fear will hurt pay and conditions.

Air France chairman Christian Blanc is preparing to merge the two carriers to prepare them for privatisation and to boost their competitiveness and the plan would put Air France Europe crews on the same pay scale as their Air France counterparts.
Crews at Air France Europe, also known as Air Inter Europe, are better paid. The pay scale changes stand to cut their wages by around 15 percent.
An spokeswoman for Air France said practically all flights would go ahead undisrupted by the continued protest.
